correctness.rationale: For each unit-circle ζ, M(ζ) is unitarily similar to fixed A. Hence W(T_M) subset K=W(A) by convex integration. For any extreme λ of K select supporting θ, form rational Hermitian parts H=Re(e^-iθ M), J=Im(e^-iθ M) through reflected adjoints. Fiber spectra fixed under pointwise unitary similarity, so spectral projection E onto top eigenspace of H is a rational polynomial in H, and endpoint b or a of EJE restricted to ran E is fiber independent. The rational positive-semidefinite matrix R=(h I−H)+(b E−EJE), or lower endpoint analog, has identically zero determinant and kernel exactly endpoint numerical vectors. Rational elimination over C(z) and clearing denominators yields a NONZERO analytic polynomial vector p with R p=0 a.e.; normalized H² polynomial attains λ. Convexity gives W(T_M)=K closed, every extreme point attained. The 2026 bidisk paper Corollary 5.3 pointwise rational symbols are unitarily equivalent; Proposition 7.2 finds a constant symbol for one factorable decomposition; together this theorem proves the previously conjectured all-decomposition positive direction. Nonrational u(z)=exp(z−1/z) projection has W(T_P)=(0,1), as an attaining vector would force essential-singularity cancellation impossible in H². 201 independent finite symbolic checks on the 2x2 model corroborate, not replace, the general rational-kernel proof. Degenerate zero compression numerical range empty by convention.
